lessons.title: Debating and Expressing Opinions
lessons.body: In African markets, from Kano to Nairobi, the ability to argue a point persuasively in Arabic can win you a contract or a leadership role. Practice with a partner on topics like 'Should African countries adopt a single currency?' Use a timer: 2 minutes to state your opinion, 1 minute for rebuttal. Record yourself on your phone using the Voice Memos app (available on Android and iOS) and listen for hesitation. Aim for 3 debates per week. lessons.title: Final Conversation Practice and Assessment

Then, take the final assessment: a 15-minute oral exam with a native speaker via 'iTalki' (cost: $10-20). The exam covers: fluency (30%), grammar (30%), vocabulary (20%), and pronunciation (20%).
